topics.title: Say hello to a new classmate
topics.task: A new student joined your class. Write a short message to say hello and get to know them.

topics.title: Greet your teacher politely
topics.task: Write a short exchange between you and a teacher you meet in the corridor. Be polite.
must: Greet and ask how they are

topics.title: Who is who?
topics.task: Introduce three people from a photo (a friend, a teacher, a neighbour). Say who they are.
must: Use c'est or ce sont at least twice
Say how you know each of them

topics.title: Introduce yourself
topics.task: Introduce yourself to people you meet at an international school camp.

topics.title: First message to a pen pal
topics.task: Write a first short email to a French pen pal. Tell them about yourself and ask two questions.
must: Say your name, age and where you live

topics.title: Where are they from?
topics.task: Write about four friends at a language camp. Say where each one is from and where they live.
must: Nationality for each (with the correct feminine form)
Country or city where they live

topics.title: Ages and numbers
topics.task: Write about five people you know. Give their ages and one phone number or street number.
must: One longer number written out in words

topics.title: My family
topics.task: Present your family to a new friend.
must: Names and ages of at least three people
Use mon, ma or mes correctly
Say if you have brothers or sisters
phrases: Dans ma famille, il y a ...

topics.title: One family member in detail
topics.task: Choose one family member and describe them in detail.
must: Name, age and relation to you

topics.title: My pet (or the pet I want)
topics.task: Write about your pet, or the pet you would like to have.
must: Kind of animal and its name
One thing it does every day

topics.title: A family photo
topics.task: Describe what you see in a family photo: who is there and what they are doing.
phrases: Sur la photo, il y a ...

topics.title: Describe a friend
topics.task: Describe your best friend to someone who has never met them.

topics.title: Describe yourself
topics.task: Describe yourself: how you look and what you are like.
must: At least one negative sentence (je ne suis pas ...)
One thing you like to do

topics.title: A famous person
topics.task: Describe a famous person (an athlete, musician or actor) without saying the name, so a friend can guess.

topics.title: What I am not
topics.task: Write a funny text about what you are not and what you do not have.
must: At least three sentences with ne ... pas

topics.title: My hobbies
topics.task: Tell a new friend about your free time.
must: Say what you like and what you do not like

topics.title: My sport
topics.task: Write about the sport you play: basketball, football or another.
must: Which sport and which team or club
One thing you like about it
Use jouer à or faire de correctly

topics.title: Music in my life
topics.task: Write about the music you listen to and the instruments you play.
must: Instrument (jouer de + instrument) or why you do not play one

topics.title: Questions for a new friend
topics.task: You are meeting a French exchange student tomorrow. Write the questions you want to ask.
must: Use at least three different question forms (est-ce que, intonation, question word)
Questions about hobbies, family and school

topics.title: What I love and hate
topics.task: Write a text about what you love and what you hate.
must: Three things you like with a reason
Three things you do not like with a reason
Use aimer, adorer, détester or préférer

topics.title: My school
topics.task: Describe your school to a pen pal.
must: Number of classes or students if you know
Two places in the school you like

topics.title: My favourite school day
topics.task: Write about your favourite day of the school week.

topics.title: My opinion about subjects
topics.task: Say what you think about your school subjects.
must: One subject you do not like

topics.title: At break time
topics.task: Describe what you and your friends do during the break.

topics.title: My school day
topics.task: Describe a normal school day from morning to evening.

topics.title: My morning routine
topics.task: Write about what you do every morning before school.
must: Times for at least three actions
One thing you take with you to school

topics.title: My weekend routine
topics.task: How is your Saturday different from a school day?
must: Say what time you get up
What you do in the morning and afternoon
One thing you never do on Saturdays (negation)

topics.title: What I eat and drink
topics.task: Describe your breakfast and your favourite meal of the day.
must: Food and drink at breakfast with partitive articles (du, de la, des)

topics.title: Foods I like and do not like
topics.task: Write about food: what you like and what you cannot eat.
must: Three foods you like (le, la, les)
Three foods you eat often (du, de la, des)
At least one sentence with pas de
phrases: Je ne mange pas de poisson

topics.title: At the restaurant
topics.task: Write a dialogue between you and a waiter. You order a meal.
must: Order a drink and a main course (je voudrais ...)

topics.title: My perfect dinner
topics.task: Describe the perfect dinner: what you eat and who cooks.

topics.title: Shopping list for a party
topics.task: Write a message to a friend with what you need to buy for a party.
must: At least six items with quantities (un kilo de, une bouteille de ...)
Where to buy each thing (à la boulangerie ...)

topics.title: At the shop
topics.task: Write a conversation in a bakery or a small shop.
must: Ask for at least three items
Ask the price and give the total

topics.title: A present for a friend
topics.task: Write a message to a friend about a present you want to buy for a family member.
must: What you want to buy and why

topics.title: At the market
topics.task: Describe a visit to a market: what you see and what things cost.
must: Numbers written in words at least twice
phrases: Sur le marché, il y a ...

topics.title: My room
topics.task: Describe your room to a friend who is visiting.
must: Where things are (sur, sous, à côté de)
What you do in your room
phrases: Dans ma chambre, il y a ...
Le lit est à côté de ...

topics.title: My home
topics.task: Describe the place where you live.

topics.title: Housework
topics.task: Write to a host family and say what you can do to help at home.
must: One chore you do not like

topics.title: Where is everything?
topics.task: Describe a picture of a living room. Say where each object is.
must: Il y a and il n'y a pas de
phrases: Il y a ... sur la table

topics.title: My town
topics.task: Present your town or village to a French visitor.
must: Where it is and how big it is
At least four places in town

topics.title: Giving directions
topics.task: A tourist asks you the way to the station. Write the dialogue.

topics.title: How I get around
topics.task: Write how you go to school and to your friends, and how you get to other towns.
must: Transport for at least three trips
Use en, à or par correctly
phrases: Je vais à l'école à pied

topics.title: Plans for Saturday
topics.task: Write to a friend about what you are going to do on Saturday.
must: At least four plans with aller + infinitive

topics.title: A day in the city
topics.task: Invite a friend to spend a day in town. Plan the day.
must: Where to meet and at what time

topics.title: Weather today and tomorrow
topics.task: Write a short weather report for today, tomorrow and the weekend.

topics.title: My favourite season
topics.task: Write about your favourite season and why.

topics.title: My birthday
topics.task: Write about your birthday: when it is and how you celebrate.

topics.title: A plan for the weekend
topics.task: Plan the weekend for you and a friend depending on the weather.
must: Use s'il fait ... or s'il pleut ...

topics.title: What I wear
topics.task: Describe the clothes you wear for school, for sport and for a party.
must: Clothes with colours and the correct adjective agreement

topics.title: In the clothes shop
topics.task: Write a conversation between a customer and a shop assistant.
must: Try on and give an opinion
Decision to buy or not (use le, la, les)

topics.title: Fashion: my opinion
topics.task: Write what you think about fashion and brands.
must: At least one comparison (plus ... que, moins ... que)

topics.title: Should students wear a uniform?
topics.task: Give your opinion about school uniform.
must: One argument from the other side

topics.title: What I did last weekend
topics.task: Tell a friend what you did last weekend.
must: Passé composé with avoir and être correctly
At least five actions in order

topics.title: A match I played
topics.task: Write a report about a basketball or football match you played.
must: Who you played against and where
What happened (at least five past actions)

topics.title: What happened yesterday
topics.task: Write to a friend who was ill yesterday and missed school. Tell them what happened.
must: At least five things that happened

topics.title: When I was little
topics.task: Tell how your life was when you were little.
must: Where you lived and what you looked like
At least four habits with the imparfait
One thing you did every weekend

topics.title: A postcard from my holidays
topics.task: Write a postcard to your grandparents from your holiday.
must: Where you are and with whom
One thing you will do tomorrow

topics.title: My best holiday
topics.task: Tell about the best holiday you have ever had.

topics.title: My dream trip
topics.task: Describe the trip you would like to take.
phrases: Je voudrais aller en / au / aux ...

topics.title: Booking a hotel
topics.task: Write an email to a hotel to book a room.

topics.title: At the doctor
topics.task: Write a dialogue at the doctor.
must: Describe at least two symptoms (avoir mal à ...)
How long you have been ill

topics.title: A healthy life
topics.task: Give advice on how to live healthily.
must: At least four pieces of advice (il faut, tu dois, il ne faut pas)

topics.title: An email to the teacher
topics.task: You were ill and could not come to school. Write an email to your teacher.
must: Explain why you were absent (passé composé)
phrases: Je n'ai pas pu venir parce que ...

topics.title: Sport and me
topics.task: Explain why sport matters to you and how it changes your week.

topics.title: Screen time
topics.task: Write about how much time you spend on your phone and computer.

topics.title: My favourite video game
topics.task: Describe a game you love (for example Minecraft) to someone who does not play.

topics.title: Social media: pros and cons
topics.task: Write about the good and bad sides of social media.

topics.title: Phone rules
topics.task: Write the rules for phones at school or at home.
must: Use il est interdit de, il faut or on doit
Say why one rule is useful

topics.title: A friend online
topics.task: Write a message to a friend you only know from a game or chat. Suggest meeting in a call.
must: Say who you are and what you play
Suggest a time (futur proche or présent)

topics.title: A celebration in my country
topics.task: Explain a holiday you celebrate (for example Christmas or Easter) to a French friend.
must: What you like most about it

topics.title: A party invitation
topics.task: Write an invitation to your birthday party.

topics.title: A thank you note
topics.task: Write a thank you note for a present you received.
must: Say what the present is and what you like about it
Say what you will do with it

topics.title: The best party
topics.task: Tell about the best party you have ever been to.

topics.title: My future job
topics.task: Write about the job you would like to do.

topics.title: Next year
topics.task: Write what will happen in your life next year.
must: At least five predictions with the futur simple
One thing you want to change

topics.title: What I would like to do
topics.task: Write what you would like to do in your life.
must: At least four wishes with the conditionnel

topics.title: Why I chose my school
topics.task: Explain why you chose your school and what you would like to learn there.
must: Your plans for the next years
phrases: J'ai choisi ce lycée parce que ...

topics.title: Should school start later?
topics.task: Argue for or against starting school at 9 o'clock.

topics.title: A childhood memory
topics.task: Tell a detailed memory from your childhood.

topics.title: If I were rich
topics.task: Write what you would do if you won a lot of money.
must: At least four si + imparfait + conditionnel sentences

topics.title: Applying for a summer job
topics.task: Write a formal letter to apply for a summer job.
phrases: Je me permets de vous écrire ...

topics.title: A film or series review
topics.task: Write a review of a film, series or book.

topics.title: Technology in twenty years
topics.task: How will technology change life in twenty years?

topics.title: A mystery story
topics.task: Write the beginning of a short story with a mystery.

topics.title: Should competitive sport be compulsory?
topics.task: Argue whether competitive sport should be compulsory at school.
must: Use of the subjonctif at least once (il faut que ...)

topics.title: A person who changed me
topics.task: Describe a person who influenced you.
must: Use qui, que or dont at least twice

topics.title: Reporting a conversation
topics.task: Report a conversation you had with a teacher or a friend.
must: Use reported speech (il m'a dit que ...)
